title: Waterproof Phone Pouch IPX8 for Phones up to 7 Inch, 2 Pack
description:
Keeps your phone dry at the beach, by the pool or on a kayak, and you can still use the touchscreen through the window.
• IPX8 sealed pouch with a double snap-and-lock closure
• Fits phones with screens up to 7 inches, with or without a slim case
• Clear on both sides, so you can take photos and video underwater
• Adjustable neck lanyard included with each pouch

title: Stick-On Phone Card Holder, Vegan Leather, Holds 3 Cards
description:
A slim card wallet that sticks to the back of your phone or case, so you can leave the purse at home.
• Holds up to 3 cards or folded notes; thumb hole to push cards out
• Soft vegan leather with a strong 3M-style adhesive pad
• Sticks to smooth phone backs and hard cases (not to silicone)
• Adds only 4 mm to the thickness of your phone

title: Crossbody Phone Lanyard with Adjustable Strap and Clear Patch
description:
Wear your phone across the body for festivals, city trips and walks, with your hands free and your phone always within reach.
• Strong woven strap, adjustable from 70 to 150 cm
• Thin clear patch slides between phone and case: works with almost any phone
• Metal clasp that clicks on and off in a second
• Machine washable strap

title: Tempered Glass Screen Protector, 2 Pack, with Installation Frame
description:
Tough 9H tempered glass that takes the scratches and knocks instead of your phone's screen.
• 0.33 mm thin with full touch sensitivity and fingerprint-resistant coating
• Installation frame lines the glass up for a bubble-free fit
• Includes wet and dry wipes and dust-removal stickers
• Choose the size that matches your phone's screen diagonal

title: Privacy Screen Protector, Anti-Spy Tempered Glass, 2 Pack
description:
Keeps your screen readable for you and dark for people sitting next to you on the train or in a café.
• Privacy filter blocks the view from 30° to either side
• 9H tempered glass protects against scratches and drops
• Easy installation frame and cleaning kit included
• Choose the size that matches your phone's screen diagonal

title: USB-C Fast Charger 20 W with EU Plug
description:
A small wall charger that tops up most phones to about 50% in 30 minutes.
• 20 W USB-C Power Delivery for fast charging phones and earbuds
• Compact EU plug that fits multi-socket extension leads
• Protection against overheating, overcharging and short circuits
• CE marked; cable sold separately

title: Phone Tripod Mount with LED Fill Light and Cold Shoe
description:
Turns any tripod into a vlogging rig: the clamp holds your phone and the little LED lights your face.
• Spring clamp fits phones from 5.5 to 7 cm wide
• Rechargeable LED with 3 colour temperatures and stepless dimming
• Cold shoe on top for a microphone; 1/4-inch thread underneath
• Mini tabletop tripod included

title: USB-A to USB-C Cable 1 m, Fast Charging, 3 Pack
description:
For older chargers, cars and computers that only have the classic rectangular USB port.
• USB-A plug to USB-C, up to 3 A fast charging
• USB 2.0 data transfer at 480 Mbps
• Reinforced joints tested for over 10,000 bends
• 3 cables of 1 m each

title: 3-in-1 Charging Cable with USB-C, Micro-USB and 8-Pin Tips
description:
One cable that charges almost any phone, earbuds or speaker in the house, handy for families and guests.
• USB-A plug with USB-C, Micro-USB and 8-pin connectors on one cable
• Charges up to 3 devices at once (charging only, no data)
• Braided 1.2 m cable with metal plug housings
• Ideal for the car, the office or travelling light

title: Car Charger 48 W with USB-C and USB-A Fast Charging
description:
Fast charging on the road for the driver and the passenger, from your car's 12 V socket.
• USB-C port with 30 W Power Delivery plus an 18 W USB-A port
• Works in 12 V and 24 V sockets (cars, vans and lorries)
• Sits flush with the dashboard; soft blue light to find it in the dark
• Protection against overheating and short circuits

title: 15 W Wireless Charging Pad with LED Ring
description:
Put your phone down and it starts charging: no plugging in at your desk or bedside.
• Up to 15 W for phones that support wireless charging (Qi)
• Works through thin cases up to 5 mm
• Soft LED ring shows charging status and dims at night
• USB-C cable included; use with a 20 W or stronger adapter

title: 15 W Wireless Charging Stand for Portrait or Landscape
description:
An upright wireless charger, so you can watch videos, take video calls or use face unlock while it charges.
• Two charging coils: works with the phone upright or on its side
• Up to 15 W for phones that support wireless charging (Qi)
• Non-slip base and rubber cradle
• USB-C cable included

title: 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station for Phone, Watch and Earbuds
description:
One tidy dock on the nightstand for everything you charge each night.
• Wireless pad for your phone, plus spots for a smartwatch and wireless earbuds
• Up to 15 W phone charging; 5 W for earbuds
• Uses your watch's own magnetic charger, which clips into the stand
• Power adapter and cable included

title: Car Phone Holder with Air-Vent Clip and One-Hand Release
description:
Keeps your phone at eye level for navigation, without blocking the windscreen.
• Hook-style vent clip that grips horizontal and vertical vents
• Side arms close around the phone and release with one button
• Fits phones from 4.7 to 7 inches, also in most cases
• 360° rotating head for portrait or landscape

title: Bike and Scooter Phone Mount with Quick-Lock Clamp
description:
Rides with you over cobblestones and potholes, so you can follow the map without stopping.
• Clamp fits handlebars from 22 to 32 mm, no tools needed
• Spring-loaded cradle with a locking corner guard
• Fits phones from 4.7 to 7 inches
• Rotates 360°; works on bikes, e-bikes, scooters and buggies

title: Adjustable Aluminium Phone Stand for Desk
description:
Holds your phone at a comfortable angle on the desk for calls, recipes and notifications.
• Solid aluminium with a weighted, non-slip base
• Adjustable angle and height; folds flat for your bag
• Fits phones and small tablets from 4 to 8 inches
• Cable hole so you can charge while it stands

title: Bluetooth Selfie Stick Tripod with Detachable Remote, 1.1 m
description:
A selfie stick that turns into a tripod, for group photos, travel videos and video calls.
• Extends from 19 to 110 cm; tripod legs fold out of the handle
• Detachable Bluetooth remote works up to 10 m away
• Phone clamp rotates for portrait or landscape
• Fits phones from 4.7 to 7 inches

title: Flexible Tripod with Phone Clamp and Bendable Legs
description:
Wrap the legs around a branch, railing or bike frame and shoot from angles a normal tripod can't reach.
• Bendable legs with rubber grip rings
• Phone clamp plus a standard 1/4-inch screw for small cameras
• Holds up to 1 kg
• Packs down to 26 cm

title: Clip-On Selfie Ring Light with 3 Light Modes, USB-C Rechargeable
description:
Soft, even light on your face for video calls, selfies and live streams, wherever you are.
• Clips onto phones, tablets and laptop screens
• 3 colour temperatures and 10 brightness levels
• Rechargeable via USB-C: up to 2 hours per charge
• 40 LEDs with a diffuser for a flattering glow

title: 3-in-1 Clip-On Phone Lens Kit: Wide-Angle, Macro and Fisheye
description:
Three glass lenses that clip over your phone's camera for wider landscapes, close-ups and fun fisheye shots.
• 0.6x wide-angle, 15x macro and 180° fisheye lens
• Multi-coated optical glass for sharp, clear photos
• Universal clip fits most phones; remove thick cases first
• Lens caps and a carry pouch included
